name: The Great Beech (Andorra, Wissahickon)
reason: Pennsylvania champion (2006), 257 in circumference, 105 ft spread, 102.5 ft tall in 2017, planted 1853 to 1862 by Richard Wistar, but WHYY 3 June 2021 says it is dying: only one branch in leaf in May 2021, mostly a snag, with a root sprout 'Baby Beech' as successor; no later source found, so alive status unconfirmed. Near Wissahickon Environmental Center (OSM centre 40.0811985,-75.2339045, pin approximate). Free, trail access. Revisit if a 2024+ source shows it standing or the successor named.
